Backend: 6/6 unit tests (test_iter37_per_strategy_configs.py) + 9/9 new HTTP integration tests (test_iter37_per_strategy_configs_http.py) all PASS. Confirmed: (a) activate response returns applied (int), applied_params (dict, e.g. normal_lot_usd=150.0), ignored_account_level (contains max_concurrent_positions + max_spread_pct); (b) global /api/settings UNCHANGED after activation — normal_lot_usd stays 75.0, max_concurrent_positions stays 8 (the historical clobber bug is fixed); (c) /api/strategy/hunter/effective flips using_config true→false on activate→deactivate with matching overrides; (d) /api/strategy/metrics returns hunter.active_config_id + active_config_name after activation; (e) activate is blocked (400) for a config with validation_status != 'passed'; (f) route ordering — /strategy/{key}/effective and /strategy/{key}/deactivate are reachable for both hunter+squeeze (not shadowed); (g) POST /api/cycle/run/BTC returns 200 with hunter config active (engine consumes per-strategy params cleanly). WEB Research Lab → VALIDATE → SHOW ADVANCED TOOLS → Saved Configs panel: config-activate-982084a9 tapped → LIVE badge (config-live-982084a9) appears, REVERT (config-deactivate-982084a9) appears, toast 'Config activated · 15 strategy params now live · 2 account-level ignored'; REVERT → LIVE badge clears, toast 'Reverted to default · hunter now uses the global baseline'. P2 Strategy Import regression re-verified: 17/17 iter36 pytest still PASS (1 real LLM analyze call). Cleanup done: TEST_iter37_ui config deactivated + deleted, hunter reverted to defaults. MOBILE: testIDs config-activate-<id8>, config-live-<id8>, config-deactivate-<id8> are present and correctly wired in /app/mobile/app/strategy/[id].tsx — the Configs card renders + rows visible on /strategy/hunter — BUT tapping ACTIVATE triggers Alert.alert(title, msg, [Cancel, Activate]) which is a no-op on react-native-web (Expo web preview): no confirm dialog renders, callbacks never fire, so the flow cannot complete via web preview. This is a react-native-web limitation; on native iOS/Android the buttons do work. This is the ONLY mobile parity gap.

ui_bugs.issue: Uses React Native Alert.alert(title, message, [Cancel, Activate|Revert]) for owner-confirmation. On react-native-web (Expo web preview), Alert.alert with buttons is effectively a no-op — no dialog renders and the onPress callback is never invoked, so the whole ACTIVATE/REVERT flow silently does nothing when exercised via the web preview. Native iOS/Android would work. Recommend a cross-platform confirm helper: on web, branch to window.confirm(message) (or an in-app <Modal> with two Pressables) and only use Alert.alert on native (Platform.OS !== 'web'). Reference: /app/mobile/app/strategy/[id].tsx:151-159 (activate) and :164-172 (deactivate).

parity_issues.issue: On web preview, ACTIVATE + REVERT taps do nothing (Alert.alert(title,msg,buttons) is a no-op on react-native-web). Web (SavedConfigsPanel) works end-to-end without any confirmation step and shows LIVE badge + toast.
parity_issues.expected: Tapping ACTIVATE should confirm and hit /api/strategy/configs/{id}/activate, then show LIVE badge + REVERT button. Tapping REVERT should confirm and hit /api/strategy/{key}/deactivate, then clear LIVE.
parity_issues.actual: Tap on ACTIVATE renders nothing on web preview; backend not called; UI unchanged. Same for REVERT.

Same treatment for the Revert flow (line ~164). This restores full parity with web SavedConfigsPanel behaviour.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter37 verified backend contract for P3 Phase A end-to-end. HTTP suite tests/test_iter37_per_strategy_configs_http.py is stable and quick (~8s, 1 cycle/run/BTC call). One outstanding UI issue on mobile web preview: Alert.alert(title, msg, buttons) is a no-op on react-native-web so Activate/Revert taps silently do nothing on the Expo web surface — testIDs and wiring are all correct; the fix is Platform.OS-aware confirm. To create a validated hunter config: POST /api/strategy/configs {strategy_key:'hunter', name:..., params:{normal_lot_usd:150.0, rsi_reset_max:42.0}} → PUT /api/strategy/configs/{id} {validation_status:'passed'} → POST /api/strategy/configs/{id}/activate. IMPORTANT: keep max_spread_pct <= 2.0 (clamp hi); values above cause 422 on create. Always deactivate + delete after testing to preserve the shared engine defaults. Do NOT run more than one cycle/run per session.
rca of the issue: Mobile Activate/Revert no-op on web preview — RCA: React Native's Alert.alert on react-native-web (Expo Web) does not render a multi-button confirmation modal; the buttons parameter is ignored and the onPress callbacks are never invoked. Repro: viewport 390x844, goto /strategy/hunter, seed ananta_owner_token in localStorage, tap [data-testid=config-activate-982084a9] → no dialog appears (page.on('dialog') never fires), backend /api/strategy/configs/{id}/activate is never called, LIVE badge never renders. Fix: introduce a helper `confirmAsync(title, message, ok='OK')` that on Platform.OS==='web' returns Promise<boolean> via window.confirm and on native wraps Alert.alert. Then StrategyConfigs.activate / .deactivate become linear async functions.
